info.name: Apple Pay JS Merchant Registration API
Register a merchant for Apple Pay on the Web

items.docs: Registers a merchant domain for Apple Pay on the Web. The merchant must host a domain verification file at /.well-known/apple-developer-merchantid-domain-association before calling this endpoint.

info.name: Apple Pay List registered merchant domains

params.name: merchantIdentifier
params.description: The merchant identifier issued by Apple

items.docs: Returns a list of domains that have been registered for Apple Pay on the Web for the authenticated merchant.

info.name: Apple Pay Remove a registered merchant domain

params.name: merchantIdentifier
params.description: The merchant identifier issued by Apple

items.docs: Removes a previously registered domain from the merchant's Apple Pay on the Web configuration.
